policy: Context evidence is mandatory. Pattern matches route review and never confirm meaning, emotion, pronunciation or listening approval.
default_action: NEEDS_REVIEW when context is ambiguous; preserve canonical spelling and use only checked engine phoneme overrides

shushing.limit: No default shushing phoneme; chosen engine-inventory phonemes and resulting audio require listening review. Repeating a phoneme does not prove a natural shush.

interjections.required_distinction: thought, doubt, agreement, surprise, pain, hesitation, mockery or a lexical utterance
interjections.limit: No automatic laughter, breaths or screams; Kokoro is not guaranteed to generate natural non-speech reactions.

abbreviations.required_distinction: word, letter, initialism, title, code or domain-specific abbreviation
abbreviations.limit: No global uppercase spelling or unconfirmed expansion.

numbers.required_distinction: quantity, ordinal, room, ID, telephone, date, time, decimal, fraction, percent, currency, range, negative or unit
numbers.limit: Keep value, leading zeroes, units and currency. Configuration values outside canonical_text are never spoken.

names.required_distinction: confirmed character, address, relationship, place or specialist term using versioned glossary
names.limit: Spelling is unchanged; an override is not confirmed without source evidence and listening review.

homographs.required_distinction: part of speech, tense and intended sense
homographs.limit: Never apply a single phoneme to all occurrences.

punctuation.required_distinction: statement, question, negation, command, quote, interruption, hesitation, hyphen, dialogue dash or minus
punctuation.limit: Preserve internal pauses, negation and conjunctions; do not infer emotion from punctuation or casing alone.

delivery.limit: Kokoro adapter has no prompt-based acting, emotion, whisper, pitch or SSML control. Labels are stored as unsupported and never spoken.

reviews.pronunciation: PENDING until an actual independent review receipt is recorded
reviews.listening: PENDING for native and fitted audio separately
reviews.semantic: PENDING until an actual independent review receipt is recorded
